name: Carl Jung
notes: Q4 psychoid/unus mundus is neutral; Q11 no: he doubted ego-less awareness; Q13 the unconscious is partly timeless, which clashes with the No wording.

name: Ken Wilber
notes: Q5 no: a nondual ground, though he includes 2nd-person God; Q9 no: he rejects quantum mysticism; Q13 no: the timeless Now.

name: Dean Radin
notes: Q13 presentiment points both ways: time matters, but the mind is not bound by it.

name: Rupert Sheldrake
notes: Q4 he leans panpsychist within a Christian frame; Q6 no: an extended mind, not Cartesian; Q13 yes: memory and habit are central.

name: Brian Josephson
notes: Q11 yes from TM's pure consciousness; Q5 unsure: open to a cosmic intelligence.

name: Charles Tart
notes: Q6 yes: he calls himself a 'pragmatic dualist'; many of the rest go beyond what he has written.

name: Jonathan Schooler
notes: Q13/Q9 yes: subjective time is his theme; he is publicly agnostic on psi and survival.

name: Jorge Ferrer
notes: Q11 no: a contextualist critic of pure consciousness events; Q4 no: the generative 'Mystery' isn't consciousness-first; Q12 he rejects Wilber-style hierarchy.

name: Imants Baruss
notes: Q4 yes (Transcendent Mind); Q13 unsure: he treats time as non-fundamental.

name: Julia Mossbridge
notes: Q13 and Q9 yes: precognition and time are her core work; Q5 unsure: love-centred, not clearly a personal God.

name: Marilyn Schlitz
notes: Q7 yes via healing intention and interconnection; most metaphysical items are unsettled in her writing.

name: Brian Swimme
notes: Q12 yes: the core of cosmogenesis; Q4 unsure: interiority all the way down, not idealism.

name: Allan Combs
notes: Q12 yes: the evolution of consciousness; Q4 yes: leans consciousness-fundamental.

name: Jacobo Grinberg
notes: Q9 yes: syntergic theory needs a 'lattice' beyond current physics.

name: Edward F. Kelly
notes: Q6 unsure: filter/transmission theory is dualist-sounding but he leans toward idealism; Q4 yes per Beyond Physicalism.
